sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: How To Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B is an open 30B parameter, 3B active hybrid reasoning MoE model built for high-volume task execution in long-running agents. It is designed for frequent agent calls including tool use, output validation, result formatting and subagent delegation. The model runs on 20GB RAM for 4-bit and 33GB for 8-bit.
